answer: Pearls form only around a real irritant, and identity here works the same way. Each new account posts a 50,000 POA escrow bond and names an established sponsor who cosigns it. The sponsor keeps 200,000 POA locked for 30 days. If jurors convict the sponsored account as sybil, the sponsor forfeits half and loses 20% of their standing. Each slashing is carved in umber on the public record, a marble tablet the whole network reads. Forging 10,000 clones would lock 500 million tokens and expose 2,000 sponsors to slashing.
